authenticity_review: The image exhibits high technical quality in lighting, texture rendering (wood grain, painted stripe patterns), and composition. However, it suffers from significant semantic failures: complete absence of bears (0/6), incorrect elephant count (6/7), and incorrect violin count (7/6). The tiger-striped elephants represent successful prompt adherence to an unnatural attribute but constitute a biological hallucination. Violin structures are largely sound, though minor string/bridge merging exists on smaller background instruments. The bear omission is the most critical defect.
key_defects: Complete absence of bears (0 instead of 6)
Biologically impossible tiger-stripe texture on elephants
